name: Goals
summary: Give Claude a finish line and it keeps working, turn after turn, until it gets there.
what: With /goal you describe a condition, such as all tests passing. After every turn a separate model checks the conversation and decides whether the goal is met or impossible. Until then, Claude keeps going.

impact.title: Less babysitting
impact.detail: Multi-step work continues without a new prompt each turn.

impact.title: An independent judge
impact.detail: A fresh evaluator, not the working model, decides when it's done.

impact.title: Works in scripts too
impact.detail: Use it with claude -p and in the desktop app.

howItWorks: Run /goal <condition>; run /goal alone to see its status.
Write a condition the conversation can prove, and add a turn limit if you like.
The checks use extra tokens on top of the main work.
Not available when hooks are turned off for the workspace.
